label: Breach Data Classes Exposed
cap: Which kinds of data leaked with the address in each known breach (passwords, phone numbers, dates of birth). Tool: HaveIBeenPwned. Proposed confidence 92/100. Needs the person's consent (MPC-11307).

label: Leaked Credentials and Password Hashes
cap: Whether a password or password hash tied to the address sits in leaked databases. Tool: Dehashed. Proposed confidence 70/100. Never store or show the password or hash; keep only yes/no, count and source name. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

label: Breach-Linked Identity Details
cap: Name, phone, address, IP or username that leaked in the same record as the email. Tool: Dehashed. Proposed confidence 62/100. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

label: Username Reuse Across Platforms
cap: The same username registered on many sites, linking separate accounts into one profile. Tools: Sherlock, WhatsMyName. Proposed confidence 55/100 for a single-tool hit. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

label: Google Account Footprint
cap: Whether the address is a Google account and what is public on it: account ID, name, photo, Maps reviews and photos, YouTube channel, calendar. Tool: GHunt (needs a signed-in Google session on our side). Proposed confidence 78/100. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

label: Email Registration Footprint
cap: The services where this address already has an account (around 120 sites checked). Tool: Holehe. Proposed confidence 66/100. Raise risk to High if a dating, adult, health or finance site is found. Needs consent (MPC-11307).
